About the Bike Bakersfield Full Moon Ride group ride

The Central Valley's bike coalition and community bike kitchen runs a monthly full moon night ride, posted each month on its Instagram. Casual pace, any bike. The organization also runs a shop at 1708 Chester Ave and bike rodeos.
